title: RTMP listener
description: Where to wait for a publisher. The defaults take anyone who publishes to port 1935, which is what every encoder offers.

port.title: Port
port.description: The TCP port to listen on. 1935 is the RTMP default and the one an encoder fills in by itself. A port below 1024 needs privileges this process usually does not have.

bind.title: Interface
bind.description: 0.0.0.0 listens on every interface, which is what a publisher on the same network needs. Give one address to listen on that one only.

app.title: Application name
app.description: The first part of the publish path: rtmp://host:1935/<app>/<key>. Empty accepts whatever the publisher asks for, which is why nothing has to be configured at either end.

stream_key.title: Stream key
stream_key.description: The rest of the publish path. Empty accepts any key. Set one to make this source take only the publisher that knows it, which is the closest RTMP gets to a password.

relay.title: Relay address
relay.description: Filled in by ingest/discover when it, rather than this source, owns the listening port. Leave it empty and this source listens for itself.
